BIBLE-2tj: as of 2026-08-12 commit 3feaec9. 23 content files + 7 ADRs. STAGE 16 done: 00p-sacrifice-priesthood-and-fulfillment.md. PLUS NEW GOVERNANCE FILE: 00-methodology-current.md (v1.0).

READ 00-methodology-current.md FIRST BEFORE INGESTING ANY NEW TRANCHE. It holds the ingestion protocol (read method -> ingest -> classify -> verify by retrieval -> preserve manuscript voice -> update topical -> update spine -> record corrections -> commit+push), the 12-POINT EVIDENCE STRUCTURE (textual observation / immediate context / lexical / intratextual / intertextual / historical / interpretation / hypothesis / objections / confidence / unresolved / FALSIFICATION CONDITIONS), the four formal rules in execution order, the two instruments, source policy, side-branch handling, verification honesty, change log. Created because 00b had grown into a reference work and a checklist buried in a reference work stops getting run. 00b remains authority on what rules MEAN; 00-methodology-current is the EXECUTABLE version.

STAGE 16 CONTENT: sequencing constraint HONORED — Leviticus 16 read first on its own terms (sections 1-3), Hebrews not until section 7. Lev 16:6 mediator must atone for himself + annual repetition (Heb 7:27 answers this exact limitation later). TWO GOATS TWO MOVEMENTS: blood atones (16:15), live goat BEARS SINS AWAY (16:21-22) — recorded before Hebrews opened so not retrofitted. Isaiah 53 concentrates sacrificial categories into a PERSON before any NT writer.

THE MODEL (the thing Stage 14 was missing): Heb 8:5 / 9:23 / 10:1 'shadow, copy, pattern' = PATTERN -> REALITY, not falsehood -> truth. Definition reached: fulfillment can mean an earlier God-given institution reaches its intended goal in Messiah, so continuing the earlier form AS THOUGH fulfillment had not occurred would misunderstand the institution's own purpose. POSTURE ARGUMENT: Levitical priest STANDS daily; Messiah offers once and SITS DOWN (Heb 10:11-12, all three translations preserve it); 'sat down at the right hand' = Psalm 110:1 citation.

RECONCILES Matt 5:18 with Heb 7:12 by distinguishing the Torah's TRUTH from its ADMINISTRATION — different axes, not a compromise. HONEST LIMIT: resolves sacrifice/priesthood, does NOT resolve Matthew 5:19 (open q 15).

THREE TABLE ROWS with explicit apostolic interpretation (sacrifice / high priesthood / sanctuary access) — every row shaped 'reality retained, form transformed'.

SECTION 18 BRAKE APPLIED PREEMPTIVELY against this stage's own most attractive conclusion: a model discovered in one area is a POSSIBILITY FRAMEWORK, not an automatic answer elsewhere. Sabbath/food/festivals each need own evidence.

TWO SIDEBARS: Hebrews is NOT calling Leviticus a lie (distinguishes ritual/covenantal effectiveness WITHIN the appointed system from ultimate removal of sin); 'once for all' does NOT mean Yeshua stopped being priest (sacrifice completed, intercession continuing, Heb 7:25).

PSALM 110 holds both offices in one Psalm (v1 enthronement, v4 priesthood) — retroactively confirms Stage 9 king-priest observation. Direction matters: observation came first, evidence later.

FOUR NEW CONTRARY/VERIFICATION FINDINGS:
1. ISAIAH 53:10 — CJB reads a CONDITIONAL ('to see IF he would present himself as a guilt offering. IF he does') where ESV/RVR1960 read 'when'. asham present in all three; the CERTAINTY of the assertion varies. Open q 24.
2. MATTHEW 26:28 — 'new' is TEXT-CRITICALLY CONTESTED (Byzantine has it, critical text omits; CJB's 'ratifies the New Covenant' is interpretive). Claim 'Yeshua Himself called it the New Covenant' REASSIGNED to Luke 22:20 / 1 Cor 11:25 where secure. Open q 23.
3. HEBREWS 7:24 aparabaton — ESV 'permanently' (duration) vs CJB 'does not pass on to someone else' (succession). Both lexically available, converge in context, not the same claim.
4. LEV 16 AZAZEL — all three translations TRANSLITERATE rather than rendering 'scapegoat' (that gloss is KJV's, origin of the English word). Does NOT establish personal referent; DOES unsettle the assumed gloss.

AZAZEL SIDE BRANCH (open q 22) — preserved at point of origin, does NOT reorder main argument. ESTABLISHED: Azazel at Lev 16:8/10/26, la-Azazel into the wilderness. NOT VERIFIED: all 1 Enoch claims (Semihazah leads oath in ch6, Azazel teaches metalworking/weapons ch8, Raphael binds Azazel in desert ch10) — VERIFICATION ATTEMPT RETURNED HTTP 403 on sacred-texts.com. Includes a CORRECTION to the recollection (oath-leader is Semihazah NOT Azazel) which is ITSELF unverified — two layers of provisionality both preserved. GOVERNING BRAKE: do not let 1 Enoch define Leviticus before Leviticus is exegeted on its own terms (Intertextual Priority run BACKWARDS is the error the rule prevents). Inherits the Jude-quoting-Enoch constraint from open q 5.

TERMINOLOGY CORRECTION: 'ecumenological discipline' -> 'BIBLICAL EPISTEMOLOGICAL FRAMEWORK'. Ecumenology already means denominational-unity theology — real term collision, would mislead a reader of the eventual book. Glossary now has epistemology / exegesis / hermeneutics / intertextuality / intratextuality / lexical analysis.

00a spine: 16 stages, 14 corrections preserved (3 are this project's OWN formulations). Superseded 'next stage' entry preserved rather than overwritten. Audit also caught+fixed a stale '(current)' marker on Stage 12.

NEXT STAGE: CIRCUMCISION — deliberately a DIFFERENT KIND of command, so a real test not a repeat. Predates Sinai entirely (Gen 17:10-11, everlasting covenant sign to Abraham) yet Acts 15 + Paul refuse to require it of believing Gentiles. QUESTION: how can something commanded as an 'everlasting covenant' cease to function as the required physical boundary marker for Gentile membership? CHAIN: Gen 17 -> Deut 10/30 -> Jer 4 -> Acts 15 -> Rom 2 -> Rom 4 -> Gal 3/5/6 -> 1 Cor 7. MAY OVERTURN the idea that the distinction is simply 'Mosaic command vs New Covenant' — because some covenant signs PREDATE MOSES yet are still transformed. If so, Stage 16's table needs a column it doesn't have. Live unresolved problem carried in: 1 Cor 7:19 (open q 21).
